flawed_step: Step 1: The required inference that 2-connectivity together with all degrees even guarantees a spanning cycle cannot be justified.
counterexample: K_{2,4}. It is finite, simple, Eulerian (degrees are 4,4,2,2,2,2), and remains connected after deleting any vertex. It is not Hamiltonian because every cycle in a bipartite graph contains equally many vertices from both parts, whereas its parts have sizes 2 and 4.
assessment_summary: The proposed universal statement is false, so a proof cannot proceed past the first inference of Hamiltonicity from the two hypotheses.
